```artifact
Feature: Doctor Consultation and Prescription Management

  Scenario: Doctor views pending appointments
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor navigates to the appointment list
    Then the doctor should see a list of pending consultation requests

  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation and generates prescription
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor accepts the consultation request
    And the doctor provides consultation notes
    And the doctor prescribes a medicine
    And the doctor generates a prescription
    Then the prescription should be generated and sent to the concerned Chemist

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor accepts the consultation request
    And the doctor prescribes a lab test
    Then the lab test should be created and sent to the lab for processing

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicines
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request
    When the doctor accepts the consultation request
    And the doctor prescribes a medicine
    Then the medicine should be requested to the concerned Chemist for delivery

  Scenario: Lab tests are performed and reports are updated
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request with a prescribed lab test
    When the lab test is performed
    And the lab report is received
    Then the lab report should be updated in the system

  Scenario: Lab report is released for viewing
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And there is a pending consultation request with a lab test report
    When the doctor navigates to the consultation request
    Then the doctor should see the lab report for the patient
```
